query: Which voucher modality and operational specs (paper vs e-voucher; real-time vs periodic reimbursement; fraud checks; retailer liquidity support) best balance feasibility, fraud risk, and scalability?

response.query: Which voucher modality and operational specs (paper vs e-voucher; real-time vs periodic reimbursement; fraud checks; retailer liquidity support) best balance feasibility, fraud risk, and scalability?
response.answer: E-vouchers with real-time reimbursement and robust fraud checks balance feasibility, fraud risk, and scalability. Retailer liquidity support enhances program efficiency.
